race.comment: ZOU FORCE (4) is ready to return after enjoying a successful debut prep where he got off the mark here in his second outing. Only missed by a head on Town Plate day from making it two on the bounce before spelling. Looks a promising type. PARIAH FLYER (8) was doing her best work late last start to get up for second over 1175m at Albury. Can settle closer from the inside draw and is expected to be there at the business end. COSTALIVIN (10) was in control from the outset to score as favourite on debut over 1200m at this track five months ago and has not appeared since. Has upside and looks a key runner. LET UP (13) showed good early dash and stalked the pace last start before drawing clear to score over 1200m at Bathurst. Can figure in the finish again. ELLISMAYNE (2) is knocking on the door and deserves respect too.
